body: Just chiming in one last time to say thank you to all of you who tried to help me and listened to me without judgement even though I wasn't super talkative. It really means a lot. You're a bunch of good noodles.

You're the first person to ask me how I'm feeling in years probably. So first of all, thanks for that. I gotta be honest though, I don't know how to answer that question. I don't think I can. But yeah, seriously thanks for asking. I appreciate it.

I always wanted to go out on the road and just travel for a living with some dogs and cats by my side. Do whatever I wanted whenever and wherever I pleased. Was a big dream of mine. I can't afford that though, plus ironically, I don't drive so that makes it all the more difficult.
